subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.body: Meal plans that deliver on a schedule. Pause, skip a day or change the address at any time.
subscriptions.emptyBody: A meal plan delivers on a schedule you choose, with a discount for longer commitments.
subscriptions.emptyFilteredBody: No subscription is in that state at the moment.

subscription.notFoundTitle: We could not find that subscription
subscription.notFoundBody: The link may be out of date, or the subscription may belong to another account.

readOnly.draft: This subscription has not started yet.
readOnly.cancelled: It was cancelled, so nothing can be changed.
readOnly.expired: It has run its full length, so nothing can be changed.

subscription.skipSheetBody: Your next few delivery days. Skipping one leaves the rest of the schedule alone.
subscription.pauseDialogBody: Deliveries stop until you resume. Nothing is cancelled and nothing is lost.
subscription.pauseConsequenceOpen: No delivery will be scheduled until you press Resume. We will not choose a date for you.
subscription.resumeDialogBody: Deliveries start again on the next day this plan delivers on.
subscription.skipDialogDated: The delivery on {{date}} will not be made.
subscription.skipConsequenceBody: That day is removed from the schedule and the following delivery day becomes your next one. The rest of the subscription is untouched.
subscription.addressDialogBody: The new address applies from the next delivery onwards.
subscription.slotDialogBody: Pick a new window, and adjust the delivery days if you want to.
subscription.slotDaysNote: Leave these as they are to keep the current schedule. Days this plan does not deliver on will be refused by the kitchen.

cancel.doneMemo_other: A credit of {{amount}} has been recorded for {{count}} unused days.
